assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: premium fashion design web app concept preview, a real raster image to be placed inside a functional product design workbench. Scene: warm ivory seamless cyclorama and a low plaster block, refined fashion atelier product photography. Composition: portrait 4:5, entire bag and handle loops visible with breathing room, three-quarter view showing the front and right gusset, subject centered. Lighting: soft large window key from upper left, subtle grounded shadow, tactile heavyweight cotton weave, credible stitched fabric, calm editorial art direction. Palette: warm cream canvas against warm off-white; restrained, no green tint. No people, no text, no labels, no ruler, no diagram, no graphics, no watermark. This is a design mood concept, not a measured production pattern.
